name: chydevit-skills
description: Claude Code skills that make finished videos entirely in code, in three categories: video (1 minute and up: cartoons, documentaries, explainers), motion graphics (short promos, intro reels, showreels, loops) and create logo (animated logo reveals).

plugins.name: video
plugins.description: Video, 1 min and up: /comedy-cartoon-2d (1-4 min comedy and story cartoons), /khmer-2d-animation (Khmer chibi folk tales and lessons), /khmer-history-doc (paper-cut history documentaries), /khmer-memory-doc (15 min remembrance documentaries), /flat-explainer-doc (flat science / history explainers), /kids-cartoon-video (3D kids' learning episodes).

plugins.name: motion-graphics
plugins.description: Motion graphics, under 1 min: /portfolio-reel (30 s creator / developer intro reels, classic or app UI, 5 styles), /saas-promo (11 s product promos, or 50 s cut on the beat of your song), /brand-promo (50 s studio showreels with narration), /brand-loop (seamless 4K looping backgrounds).

plugins.name: create-logo
plugins.description: Create logo: /generate-logo turns any logo image into 5-second animated logo reveals in five styles (liquid, neon, bounce, lens, rise), with sound and transparent versions.
